name: DINOv2
plain: Meta's DINOv2: self-supervised image features (patch and class tokens) in four sizes, with and without register tokens.
summary: DINOv2 (Oquab et al. 2023, Meta): self-supervised ViT backbones; patch + cls token features at any size; -reg = with 4 register tokens.

papers.title: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision

task_io: Input: one RGB image. Output: dense patch features and a pooled image feature.

variants.name: dinov2-vits14

licence.evidence: https://github.com/facebookresearch/dinov2/blob/7764ea0/README.md (License section: code and model weights under Apache 2.0)
licence.training_note: LVD-142M: 142M images retrieved from web crawls by similarity to curated datasets (ImageNet-22k/1k train, Google Landmarks, fine-grained sets), self-supervised (no labels), per the paper; not released

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model

original16.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = first call; float16

original32.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = first call; float32

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

kernels.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

quality.title: ImageNet-1k val, kNN top-1 % (k = 20, 10000 labelled / 5000 test images)
quality.protocol: Two disjoint seeded subsets of the val folders; each image shorter side 256 (bicubic), centre crop 224, the CLS / pooled feature; cosine kNN, vote weighted by similarity.

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.0001 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 2.5 % and p99 <= 12 % of the reference's median |value| (absolute error of the output `last_hidden_state`).
